name: duotronic/wprism-dev
description: Developer-only toolchain for the WPrism WordPress drop-in. Never shipped: adoption assembles the source adapter packages inside a staged agent and archives exactly that agent plus recovery.

scripts.check-vendor: test -f vendor/autoload.php || { echo 'composer check: vendor/ is not installed -- run: composer install' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.lint: dirs=''; for d in agent adapter-packages cli recovery scripts tools tests sandbox integration-scenarios; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then dirs="$dirs $d"; fi; done; { find $dirs -type f -name '*.php' -print0; if [ -d cli ]; then find cli -maxdepth 1 -type f -name wprism -print0; fi; } | xargs -0 -P 8 -n 1 php -l > /dev/null && echo 'lint: ok'
scripts.cs: kept=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$kept"' EXIT; { git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main... -- '*.php' 2>/dev/null; git diff -z --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- '*.php'; } | sort -zu | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do case "$f" in agent/*|cli/*|recovery/*|scripts/*|tools/*|tests/*|sandbox/*|integration-scenarios/*) [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\0' "$f" ;; esac; done > "$kept"; if [ -s "$kept" ]; then xargs -0 php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php -- < "$kept"; else echo 'cs: no changed php files'; fi
scripts.cs:fix: kept=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$kept"' EXIT; { git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main... -- '*.php' 2>/dev/null; git diff -z --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- '*.php'; } | sort -zu | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do case "$f" in agent/*|cli/*|recovery/*|scripts/*|tools/*|tests/*|sandbox/*|integration-scenarios/*) [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\0' "$f" ;; esac; done > "$kept"; if [ -s "$kept" ]; then xargs -0 php-cs-fixer fix --diff --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php -- < "$kept"; else echo 'cs: no changed php files'; fi

scripts-descriptions.check: lint + phpstan + php-cs-fixer (changed files) + phpunit — the whole dev gate.
scripts-descriptions.check-vendor: Fail fast with a named remedy when vendor/ is missing, instead of letting @stan die 'phpstan: command not found' with no explanation.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every first-party PHP file, 8-way parallel — including package-owned tests, integration scenarios, the sandbox corpus, and digest-bound adapter runtime hooks under adapter-packages/*/package/runtime/. Adapter package files are deliberately absent from the global 'cs'/'cs:fix' path filter: ArtifactPolicyIdentity::manifest_rows() hashes each runtime file into its adapter digest, so an incidental reformat would refuse deployed compiled artifacts.
scripts-descriptions.stan: phpstan analyse over the whole tree at the committed baseline (see phpstan-baseline.neon and the ceiling ratchet test).
scripts-descriptions.cs: php-cs-fixer --dry-run over changed PHP files only (never the whole tree: a mass reformat buries the change under review, and agent/, cli/ and recovery/ are bytes that reach a managed site — see .php-cs-fixer.dist.php's own header).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Same changed-files selection as 'cs', but rewrites those files in place instead of reporting a diff.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: phpunit over tests/ (fast, no docker, no WordPress bootstrap).
